title: Aepytus
summary: Raleigh names Aepytus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Aepytus, also printed Aegytus, of whose stock the Messenians were told to sacrifice a Virgin, and of whose house Aristomenes was. The two spellings are one man. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XXVII, §. IV, sig. 365a–365b
